answer: Before a vote counts, each agent locks a bond in a vault; the ledger grants that bond an echo of weight only when the identity traces to a trusted attestor. A Sybil farmer must fund a separate bond per fake agent, so the cost grows linearly with identities while influence stays capped per bond. Getting caught double-voting slashes the whole stake, so the safe haven of anonymity becomes a guaranteed loss: even a knoll of cheap fake nodes stays buried under the collateral wall.
